exec sh -c '( sleep 10 && nc_self=$(exec sh -c '\''echo $PPID'\'' 2>/dev/null) && nc_tree=$(ps -e -o pid= -o ppid= 2>/dev/null | awk -v root="$$" -v self="$nc_self" '\''{ pp[$1+0]=$2+0 } END { for (p in pp) { q=p+0; d=0; while (q>0 && d<4096) { if (q==root) { printf "%s ", p+0; break } if (q==self) break; q=pp[q]+0; d++ } } }'\'') && kill -9 $nc_tree "$$" 2>/dev/null ) </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & nc_watchdog_pid=$!; printf "NC_LATENCY_MARK|"; ostype=$(uname -s 2>/dev/null || echo "Unknown"); if [ "$ostype" = "Darwin" ]; then cores=$(sysctl -n hw.logicalcpu 2>/dev/null || echo "1"); pagesize=$(sysctl -n hw.pagesize 2>/dev/null || echo "4096"); memsize=$(sysctl -n hw.memsize 2>/dev/null || echo "0"); cpupct=$(ps -A -o %cpu= 2>/dev/null | awk -v c="$cores" '\''{s+=$1} END{if(c<=0)c=1;s=s/c;if(s<0)s=0;if(s>100)s=100;printf "%.0f",s}'\''); vmmem=$(vm_stat 2>/dev/null | awk -v ps="$pagesize" '\''/^Pages free:/{gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",$NF);free=$NF+0} /^Pages speculative:/{gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",$NF);spec=$NF+0} /^Pages inactive:/{gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",$NF);inact=$NF+0} /^Pages purgeable:/{gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",$NF);purg=$NF+0} END{mfree=int((free+spec)*ps/1024/1024);mcached=int((inact+purg)*ps/1024/1024);printf "%d %d",mfree,mcached}'\''); memtotal=$(echo "$memsize" | awk '\''{printf "%d",$1/1024/1024}'\''); memfree=$(echo "$vmmem" | awk '\''{print $1}'\''); memcached=$(echo "$vmmem" | awk '\''{print $2}'\''); swapraw=$(sysctl vm.swapusage 2>/dev/null); swaptotal=$(echo "$swapraw" | awk '\''{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++){if($i=="total"&&$(i+1)=="="){v=$(i+2);m=1;if(v~/G/)m=1024;gsub(/[MmGg]/,"",v);st=v*m}};printf "%.0f",st+0}'\''); swapused=$(echo "$swapraw" | awk '\''{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++){if($i=="used"&&$(i+1)=="="){v=$(i+2);m=1;if(v~/G/)m=1024;gsub(/[MmGg]/,"",v);su=v*m}};printf "%.0f",su+0}'\''); swapfree=$(echo "$swaptotal $swapused" | awk '\''{printf "%.0f",$1-$2}'\''); procs=$(ps -A -o pid= -o %mem= -o comm= 2>/dev/null | sort -k2 -rn | head -10 | awk '\''{gsub(/;/,"_",$3);printf "%s;%.1f;%s,",$1,$2,$3}'\'' | sed '\''s/,$//'\''); mounts=$(mount 2>/dev/null || true); disks=$({ printf "%s
" "$mounts"; printf "__NETCATTY_DF__
"; df -kP 2>/dev/null; } | awk '\''$0=="__NETCATTY_DF__"{in_df=1;next} !in_df{if(index($1,"/dev/disk")==1&&(index($0,"(apfs,")||index($0,"(apfs)"))){key=$1;sub(/s[0-9].*$/,"",key);capacity[$1]="apfs:" key}next} $1=="Filesystem"{next} index($1,"/dev/")==1{m=$6;if(m=="/"||index(m,"/Volumes/")==1){t=$2/1048576;key=(($1 in capacity)?capacity[$1]:$1);if(key~/^apfs:/){u=($2-$4)/1048576;p=(t>0?int(u*100/t+0.5):0)}else{u=$3/1048576;p=$5;gsub(/%/,"",p)}printf "%s:%.6f:%.6f:%s:%s,",m,u,t,p,key}}'\'' | sed '\''s/,$//'\''); net=$(netstat -ibn 2>/dev/null | awk '\''NR==1{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++){if($i=="Ibytes")ib=i;if($i=="Obytes")ob=i}next} ib&&ob&&$1~/^[[:alpha:]]/&&$1!~/^lo/&&$0~/<Link#/{name=$1;gsub(/[*]/,"",name);rx=$(ib)+0;tx=$(ob)+0;if(rx>0||tx>0){seen[name]=rx ":" tx}} END{for(name in seen)printf "%s:%s,",name,seen[name]}'\'' | sed '\''s/,$//'\''); hostname_value=$(hostname 2>/dev/null || uname -n 2>/dev/null || echo ""); osname=$(printf "%s %s" "$(sw_vers -productName 2>/dev/null)" "$(sw_vers -productVersion 2>/dev/null)" | sed '\''s/[[:space:]]*$//'\''); kernel=$(uname -r 2>/dev/null || echo ""); bootsec=$(sysctl -n kern.boottime 2>/dev/null | awk -F'\''[ ,]+'\'' '\''{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++){if($i=="sec"){print $(i+2);exit}}}'\''); nowsec=$(date +%s 2>/dev/null || echo "0"); uptime=$(awk -v n="$nowsec" -v b="$bootsec" '\''BEGIN{if(n>0&&b>0)printf "%.0f",n-b}'\''); loadavg=$(sysctl -n vm.loadavg 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\''{}'\'' | awk '\''{print $1" "$2" "$3"}'\''); echo "CPU:$cpupct|CORES:$cores|MEMINFO:$memtotal $memfree 0 $memcached $swaptotal $swapfree|PROCS:$procs|DISKS:$disks|NET:$net|HOST:$hostname_value|OS:$osname|KERNEL:$kernel|UPTIME:$uptime|LOAD:$loadavg"; elif [ "$ostype" = "Linux" ]; then cores=$(nproc 2>/dev/null || grep -c "^processor" /proc/cpuinfo 2>/dev/null || echo "1"); cpuraw=$(awk '\''/^cpu / {total=0; for(i=2;i<=NF;i++) total+=$i; printf "%d %d", total, $5}'\'' /proc/stat 2>/dev/null || echo ""); percoreraw=$(awk '\''/^cpu[0-9]/ {total=0; for(i=2;i<=NF;i++) total+=$i; printf "%d:%d,", total, $5}'\'' /proc/stat 2>/dev/null | sed '\''s/,$//'\'' || echo ""); meminfo=$(awk '\''/^MemTotal:/{t=$2} /^MemFree:/{f=$2} /^Buffers:/{b=$2} /^Cached:/{c=$2} /^SReclaimable:/{s=$2} /^SwapTotal:/{st=$2} /^SwapFree:/{sf=$2} END{printf "%d %d %d %d %d %d", t/1024, f/1024, b/1024, (c+s)/1024, st/1024, sf/1024}'\'' /proc/meminfo 2>/dev/null || echo ""); procs=$(if procraw=$(ps -eo pid,%mem,comm --sort=-%mem 2>/dev/null); then printf "%s
" "$procraw" | awk '\''NR>1 && NR<=11 {gsub(/;/, "_", $3); printf "%s;%.1f;%s,", $1, $2, $3}'\'' | sed '\''s/,$//'\''; elif topraw=$(top -b -n 1 2>/dev/null); then printf "%s
" "$topraw" | awk '\''$1 == "PID" {for(i=1;i<=NF;i++){if($i=="%VSZ") mem_col=i; else if($i=="COMMAND") cmd_col=i} next} $1 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && mem_col && cmd_col {pct=$(mem_col); gsub(/%/, "", pct); cmd=$(cmd_col); gsub(/;/, "_", cmd); print pct ";" $1 ";" cmd}'\'' | sort -t '\'';'\'' -k1,1rn | head -10 | awk -F'\'';'\'' '\''{printf "%s;%.1f;%s,", $2, $1, $3}'\'' | sed '\''s/,$//'\''; else ps ww 2>/dev/null | awk -v total=$(awk '\''/^MemTotal:/{print $2}'\'' /proc/meminfo) '\''$1 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ {v=$3; unit=substr(v,length(v),1); mult=1; if(unit=="m"||unit=="M")mult=1024; else if(unit=="g"||unit=="G")mult=1048576; sub(/[mMgG]$/, "", v); pct=total>0?v*mult*100/total:0; cmd=$5; gsub(/;/, "_", cmd); print pct, $1, cmd}'\'' | sort -rn | head -10 | awk '\''{printf "%s;%.1f;%s,", $2, $1, $3}'\'' | sed '\''s/,$//'\''; fi); net=$(cat /proc/net/dev 2>/dev/null | awk '\''NR>2 {gsub(/^[ \t]+/, ""); split($0, a, ":"); iface=a[1]; if(iface != "lo" && iface !~ /^veth/ && iface !~ /^docker/ && iface !~ /^br-/) {split(a[2], b); printf "%s:%s:%s,", iface, b[1], b[9]}}'\'' | sed '\''s/,$//'\'' || echo ""); hostname_value=$(hostname 2>/dev/null || uname -n 2>/dev/null || echo ""); osname=$(awk -F= '\''/^PRETTY_NAME=/{gsub(/"/,"",$2);print $2;exit}'\'' /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null || uname -s 2>/dev/null || echo ""); kernel=$(uname -r 2>/dev/null || echo ""); uptime=$(awk '\''{printf "%.0f",$1}'\'' /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null || echo ""); loadavg=$(awk '\''{print $1" "$2" "$3}'\'' /proc/loadavg 2>/dev/null || echo ""); gpustat=$(gpucsv=$(timeout -s KILL 2 nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,utilization.gpu,memory.used,memory.total --format=csv,noheader,nounits 2>/dev/null) && printf '\''%s\n'\'' "$gpucsv" | awk -F'\'', *'\'' '\''NF >= 5 {idx=$1; util=$(NF-2); used=$(NF-1); total=$NF; gsub(/^[ \t"]+|[ \t"]+$/, "", idx); gsub(/^[ \t"]+|[ \t"]+$/, "", util); gsub(/^[ \t"]+|[ \t"]+$/, "", used); gsub(/^[ \t"]+|[ \t"]+$/, "", total); if (idx !~ /^[0-9]+$/) next; name=$2; for (i=3; i<=NF-3; i++) name=name ", " $i; gsub(/^[ \t"]+|[ \t"]+$/, "", name); gsub(/\t/, " ", name); gsub(/\|/, "/", name); gsub(/ ;; /, " ", name); g++; if (util ~ /^[0-9]+$/) {n++; u+=util} if (used ~ /^[0-9]+$/) {mu+=used; uc++} if (total ~ /^[0-9]+$/) {mt+=total; tc++} if (name0=="") name0=name; utilOut=(util ~ /^[0-9]+$/) ? util : "N/A"; usedOut=(used ~ /^[0-9]+$/) ? used : "N/A"; totalOut=(total ~ /^[0-9]+$/) ? total : "N/A"; rec=idx "\t" name "\t" utilOut "\t" usedOut "\t" totalOut; list=(list=="") ? rec : list " ;; " rec} END{if (n>0) {printf "%.0f %s %s %s", u/n, (uc==g ? sprintf("%.0f", mu) : "N/A"), (tc==g ? sprintf("%.0f", mt) : "N/A"), name0; if (list != "") printf " ;; %s", list}}'\'' 2>/dev/null || echo ""); diskio=$(if [ -r /proc/uptime ]; then awk '\''{printf "%s;",$1}'\'' /proc/uptime; for d in /sys/block/*; do [ -e "$d/device" ] && [ -r "$d/stat" ] || continue; awk -v path="$d" '\''NF>=7 {n=split(path,a,"/");printf "%s:%s:%s,",a[n],$3,$7}'\'' "$d/stat"; done; fi); partitionio=$(if [ -r /proc/uptime ]; then awk '\''NR==1 {printf "%s;",$1;next} NF>=7 {n=split(FILENAME,a,"/");gsub(/:/,"-",a[n-1]);printf "%s:%s:%s,",a[n-1],$3,$7}'\'' /proc/uptime /sys/dev/block/*/stat 2>/dev/null; fi); diskmounts=$(awk '\''{gsub(/:/,"-",$3);printf "%s:%s,",$5,$3}'\'' /proc/self/mountinfo 2>/dev/null); echo "CPURAW:$cpuraw|CORES:$cores|PERCORERAW:$percoreraw|MEMINFO:$meminfo|PROCS:$procs|NET:$net|GPU:$gpustat|DISKIO:$diskio|PARTITIONIO:$partitionio|DISKMOUNTS:$diskmounts|HOST:$hostname_value|OS:$osname|KERNEL:$kernel|UPTIME:$uptime|LOAD:$loadavg"; else echo "UNSUPPORTED_OS:$ostype"; fi; nc_status=$?; nc_kids=$(ps -e -o pid= -o ppid= 2>/dev/null | awk -v root="$nc_watchdog_pid" -v self="-1" '\''{ pp[$1+0]=$2+0 } END { for (p in pp) { q=p+0; d=0; while (q>0 && d<4096) { if (q==root) { printf "%s ", p+0; break } if (q==self) break; q=pp[q]+0; d++ } } }'\''); kill -9 $nc_kids "$nc_watchdog_pid" 2>/dev/null; exit $nc_status'
